plan.title: Locked vendor addition on single-stage RFQ

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable the setting that should prevent vendor additions during event creation.
Apply the case's required read-only price-cap configuration.
Apply the case's required terms-and-conditions configuration.
Set the event type to RFQ and configure whole-lot awarding.
Provide the mandatory event title while leaving the test focused on vendor addition.
Choose the first available RFQ template so products can be added.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Verify that the All Vendors window is available.
Open the complete vendor list where a new vendor could otherwise be added.
Search for the named new vendor.
Assert that no vendor-add action is presented when additions are locked.
Assert that an alternate add-vendor control is also absent.
